statement: At receiver probe, hid-playstation allocates and registers a DualShock 4 gamepad, motion sensor input, touchpad input, battery and lightbar surface even though dongle presence starts disconnected. Later wireless loss changes dongle state and gates input parsing, without calling input-device unregister for that transition. This source path therefore retains the same Linux input objects across ordinary wireless loss and reconnect, unlike a re-probed USB dongle.

applicability.scope: Sony USB adapter lifetime versus attached-controller presence; source-level object lifetime, not measured evdev node number
